name: Sportking India Ltd
title: Sportking India Ltd - 539221 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cotton yarn spreads near 3-year highs (~$1/kg vs $0.65–0.70 prior) with Chinese demand and consolidation; management guides top line up 7–10% and QoQ margin expansion of 15–20% over next 2–3 quarters, with greenfield 150k spindles only from Q3.

utilisation.quote: we are already working at full capacity, whatever is optimum capacity, 95%, 96%

capex.peers_comment: Management said capacity across India and the world has shut down over the last 3-4 years, with consolidation continuing.
capex.quote: a lot of capacities in India, not only in India, across the world have shut down

triggers.label: Yarn price USD2.80 → USD3.30/kg
triggers.quote: they have gone up now to anywhere close to USD3.30

triggers.label: China share of exports 2–3% → 10–12%
triggers.quote: we have also increased our exports to China from almost 2%, 3% to maybe 10%, 12% in last 1 quarter

triggers.label: Top line +7–10%, margins QoQ +15–20%
triggers.quote: we expect top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters

guidance.quote: we expect top line to increase by 7% to 10% in the next three quarters
we are looking at quarter-on-quarter expanding by at least 15%, 20%
We expect the commercial operations of the project to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year
FY27 now, we expect both the companies to grow by 15% to 20% at least
